title: Communications
descriptionFa: نامه و پست، کامپیوتر و ایمیل، موبایل، و حرف زدن پشت تلفن.

words.example: I got a letter from my aunt in Canada today.
Put the photos in a big envelope.
Write the address clearly on the envelope.
Don't forget to write the date at the top of the page.
words.tipFa: date یعنی «خرما» و «قرار ملاقات» هم هست!

words.example: I need a stamp for this postcard.
Can you post this letter on your way to work?
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها mail می‌گن. post a photo یعنی «عکس پست کردن» در شبکه‌های اجتماعی.

words.example: There's a letter box at the end of our street.
words.tipFa: به شکاف نامه روی در خونه هم letter box می‌گن. آمریکایی: mailbox.

words.example: I spend eight hours a day in front of a computer.
I take my laptop to the café to work.
The screen on my phone is broken.
This keyboard has Persian and English letters.
Click on the link with the mouse.
words.tipFa: mouse یعنی «موش» هم هست. جمع موش: mice.

words.example: Save the file on a memory stick.
words.tipFa: USB stick یا flash drive هم می‌گن.

words.example: I got an email from my teacher this morning.
words.tipFa: فعل هم هست: I'll email you.

words.example: What's your email address?
words.tipFa: @ رو at و . رو dot می‌خونن: sara at mail dot com.

words.example: I buy most of my books online.
My mobile is always in my pocket.
words.tipFa: mobile phone هم می‌گن. آمریکایی: cell phone.

words.example: You can read this book on any mobile device.
When I was young, I called my parents from a phone box.
I need to make a phone call. Can I use your phone?
words.tipFa: make a call، نه do a call.

words.example: Can I have your phone number?
words.tipFa: صفر رو معمولاً oh می‌خونن: oh nine one two…

words.example: She didn't answer, so I left a voicemail.
I'll text you when I arrive.
words.tipFa: اسم هم هست: send someone a text.

words.example: There's a message for you from Ali.
Hello, can I speak to Mr Karimi, please?
words.tipFa: پشت تلفن خودت رو این‌طوری معرفی کن: It's Sara here یا This is Sara، نه I am Sara.

words.example: I'm sorry, he's in a meeting. Can I take a message?
She's busy now. Can you call back after six?
words.tipFa: با اسم یا ضمیر وسطش: I'll call you back.
